blurb: Blue Horizon offers fishing charters at the Coronado Islands, San Clemente Island, and offshore tuna trips. The vessel is equipped with modern sonar and fish finders, live tanks, refrigeration, and accommodations for up to 14 passengers for multi-day trips. It is also available for hydrographic, oceanographic, and fisheries research charters.
